tier_key.free: Free to browse. Eligible for backfill when verdict is keep or hold.
tier_key.paid: Paywalled or fee-gated subscription. Presented to users as a paid option; never ingested, and no sign-up is made.

ingest_rule: Only ingest:true sources with permitted public access may be scraped after current robots/terms checks. New regional research seeds remain hold/ingest:false pending review. Paid resources are display-only: no requests, feeds, robots requests, login, trials or scraping.
research_seed_policy: One seed per canonical URL; multiple programs on a shared calendar are retained under research_programs. Public listing access does not imply free participation. Existing published snapshots are immutable.
compensation_priority: Prioritize paid artist work, grants and stipends; include free community participation. Keep compensation, application fees, participation costs, API costs and paywalls separate. Unknown compensation is not paid.
